about: Exploratory interval-method pilots for the E1 decomposition (DECISIONS.md D-022). Synthetic data only: every dataset is simulated with planted variance components by noisefloor.recovery.simulate. Seeds come from noisefloor.recovery.PILOT_SEEDS (990000 to 990999), disjoint from the G6 and E0 part 2 seeds; nothing here is pooled with confirmatory data.

pilots.label: pilot1
pilots.design: default Design: 4 models, 40 tasks, 8 runs per (model, task) cell, batches of at most 10 runs, 3 days x 2 blocks; planted batch variance; analysis with task, model:task, and batch random effects
pilots.code: nAGQ = 0; bootstrap replicates by lme4 refit() (code before commit 3050b9d; batches assigned to slots by one global permutation)

pilots.label: pilot2
pilots.design: as pilot1 without planted batch variance and without the batch term; stopped after 18 of its 40 datasets
pilots.code: nAGQ = 0; bootstrap replicates by lme4 refit() (code before commit 3050b9d; batches assigned to slots by one global permutation)

pilots.label: pilot3
pilots.design: as pilot2 (8 runs per cell, 40 tasks)
pilots.code: nAGQ = 0; bootstrap replicates by lme4 refit() (code before commit 3050b9d; batches assigned to slots by one global permutation)

pilots.label: pilot4
pilots.design: the candidate E1 shape: 4 models, 30 tasks, the 16 runs of the half fraction in every cell, no batch variance or batch term; MDE intervals at three designs
pilots.code: nAGQ = 0; bootstrap replicates by lme4 refit() (code before commit 3050b9d; batches assigned to slots by one global permutation)

pilots.label: pilot5
pilots.design: as pilot4, also scoring studentized (bootstrap-t) boxes
pilots.code: nAGQ = 0; bootstrap replicates by lme4 refit() (code before commit 3050b9d; batches assigned to slots by one global permutation)

pilots.label: pilot6
pilots.command: python -m noisefloor.recovery pilot runs/g6-pilot/method_pilot6.jsonl 990500 25 --n-boot 200 --no-batch --tasks 30 --runs-per-cell 16 --mde --nagq 1; the same with method_pilot6b.jsonl 990525 37 --workers 2 and method_pilot6c.jsonl 990562 38 --workers 2; the three files joined in seed order
pilots.design: as pilot4 (4 models, 30 tasks, the 16 runs of the half fraction per cell, no batch variance or batch term), Laplace fits, with shares scored
pilots.code: nAGQ = 1; bootstrap replicates are fresh fits (commits 3050b9d to 1073ad3; the row computation is the same throughout); batches assigned to slots by one global permutation

pilots.label: pilot7a
pilots.design: the E1 shape of D-025 and D-028: 3 models, 30 tasks, the 16 runs of the half fraction per cell, task variance 4.0, no batch variance or batch term, no task-by-factor variation
pilots.code: nAGQ = 1; commit 6474b4c (simulator batches like local_plan; interaction effects drawn after the batch effects); only the task-jackknife boxes are scored: 2 bootstrap replicates per dataset, so the bootstrap columns are not interval estimates

pilots.label: pilot7b
pilots.command: python -m noisefloor.recovery pilot runs/g6-pilot/method_pilot7b.jsonl 990800 60 --n-boot 2 --no-batch --tasks 30 --runs-per-cell 16 --nagq 1 --n-models 3 --task-var 4.0 --fixed-interval jackknife --workers 2 --interactions harness=0.25,steps=0.25,timeout=0.25
pilots.design: as pilot7a, with planted task-by-harness, task-by-steps, and task-by-timeout variances of 0.25 each, outside the analysis model
pilots.code: nAGQ = 1; commit 6474b4c (simulator batches like local_plan; interaction effects drawn after the batch effects); only the task-jackknife boxes are scored: 2 bootstrap replicates per dataset, so the bootstrap columns are not interval estimates
